post.description:
`url` must be `https:` without credentials and resolve only to public addresses unless the server configuration allows otherwise. `types` holds event types or `prefix.*` patterns; none means every type. `sandboxId` must name a sandbox the key sees. `labels` keeps events of sandboxes that carry every label. The signing `secret` is in this answer only.

Scope: `admin`.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.

get.description:
Webhooks in creation order, without secrets. A bound key sees the ones it created.

Scope: `read`.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).
